name: KOSAIDO Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: KOSAIDO Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a printing company in Japan. The company offers printing, IT and digital solutions, and IT services; campaign, D2C business, and digital promotion support; and business process outsourcing services. It also involved in operation of crematoriums and funeral falls; provision of planning for funeral services, including wakes and farewell services; estate planning services; financial services, such as inheritance tax returns; real estate sales and purchases, loans, and asset management.
